## Manual CSV Upload
This workflow accepts a CSV uploaded through an n8n Form.

Each CSV row is converted independently into the canonical Lead schema.

Validation, identity resolution, duplicate detection, qualification, AI classification, and CRM synchronization are intentionally delegated to later workflows.

Malformed or corrupted row handling will be implemented through the validation and error workflows.

parameters.formDescription: Upload a CSV file containing leads for intake and downstream validation.
